# Mahmoud Mostafa Saber - Full-Stack Software Engineer Portfolio

> Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in scalable web applications, React & Angular ecosystems, and AI-powered solutions.

## Overview
Mahmoud Mostafa Saber is an Egyptian software engineer and graduate of the Information Technology Institute (ITI 9-Month Professional Diploma at Smart Village, Web & UI Development Track, 2025–2026) and Bachelor of Science in Computers and Information Technology from EELU (2021–2025, GPA 3.45 / 4.0, Very Good with Honors).

## Core Capabilities & Skills
- **Frontend**: React.js, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Responsive UI/UX.
- **State & Data**: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, TanStack Query, NgRx, RxJS.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, JWT Authentication, WebSockets, MongoDB, Mongoose, SQL.
- **Agentic AI & LLMs**: LLM Integration, Prompt Engineering, Fine Tuning, RAG Systems, Vector Databases (Pinecone).
- **Tooling**: Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman, Vite, Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, Jira, Agile/Scrum.
